# External research

Research done outside this repository and supplied by the user, kept verbatim, one file per
batch, named by the date it arrived. Nothing here has been checked yet. Each item gets reviewed
against the crates and the research notes: what is already covered, what is new and worth a
calculator or a test, what needs a source checked first, and what stays out.

| Batch | Items | Review status |

| [2026-10-24, cross-crate frontier regimes](2026-10-24-cross-crate-frontier-regimes.md) | (5 regimes) | [Reviewed](2026-10-24-cross-crate-frontier-regimes-review.md) 2026-10-24 |
| [2026-10-24, BAASS, Peratt and Pais (livestream summary)](2026-10-24-baass-peratt-pais-video.md) | (5 pillars) | Not reviewed |

## How a batch is reviewed

For every claim, number and formula in a batch:
1. **Already in the crates?** Name the function and its test, or the research note.
2. **New and computable?** Find the primary source, write the formula and a published test
   value, and say which crate and module it belongs in.
3. **Needs checking?** Numbers or attributions that conflict with the notes or have no source.
4. **Out of scope?** Say why.

The review of each batch is written up beside it as `<batch>-review.md`.
